requirement.value: Engineer (Tinkerer) mastery (the Merchant route is cut)

system.description: After a creature performs an Accuracy or Magic Check for an attack or offensive spell that includes you among its targets — and you may decide after seeing the Result — spend 3 Inventory Points: you gain +20 Defense and Magic Defense until the end of that turn, and cannot use this again until the start of your next turn. +20 bought after seeing the roll is very nearly a guaranteed miss. The brake is the IP: 3 against a base of 6, at tenpence a point, so an Engineer who does this twice has spent their whole inventory and five shillings.
